title: BetterPvP+
description: BetterPvP+ v1 is a lightweight PvP and performance modpack that enhances the vanilla Minecraft.
body:
BetterPvP+ v1 is a Minecraft modpack focused on PvP quality-of-life features and performance optimization while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience intact.

The modpack includes a selection of optimization mods, PvP-focused utilities, and resource packs that improve visibility and interface clarity. Features include enhanced crosshairs, locator heads, visual improvements, and other quality-of-life additions designed for PvP and multiplayer gameplay.

BetterPvP+ v1 is intended to provide a smoother Minecraft experience on a wide range of systems while maintaining compatibility with vanilla-style gameplay. Performance improvements may vary depending on your hardware, installed mods, and game settings.
